reason: The mission specialist loop (BrokeredToolSpecialist in agent_tooling.py) raised MissionError when a model deviated slightly in a required routing step: prose beside or instead of a call, an empty reply, a tool it was not offered or whose budget was spent, a reused provider call id, or finish_task with extra fields. The orchestrator then retried the turn and failed the task, and a call cut off by the output limit ran with truncated arguments because finish_reason was never checked. The routing batch is now classified call by call: a call Core will not run is answered with a failed observation (no broker call, no slot) that the next turn replays as an is_error tool result, the valid calls still run, prose is kept as bounded commentary with a warning diagnostic, a no-call reply is asked again through the routing prompt, finish ignores extra fields, output-limited calls are answered with a re-issue observation, a reused id runs under a deterministic nine-alphanumeric Core id (Gemini synthetic ids stay synthetic) while an identical repeat is answered 'already ran', and three consecutive turns that ran nothing stop the task as blocked. The finish unresolved-result guard, the unchanged-failed-invocation guard and the history failure selection ignore these Core-answered records. tests/v3/test_specialist_routing_tolerance.py (16 new tests, all failing on origin/main, including an end-to-end MissionRuntime run with max_retries=0) and tests/v3/test_specialist_tool_batches.py (two tests updated from the old hard failures, eight unchanged) prove it.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through agent_tooling.py) does not exercise mission specialist routing deviations, which need a scripted provider; the Python tests drive the specialist and MissionRuntime directly. test_orchestration.py, test_automation_runtime.py, test_browser_automation.py and test_process_results_webhook.py were run locally and pass but are not selected. No full suites.
